193  class AgentRuntimeEvaluationDriver:
  194      """Production driver that delegates execution to the frozen Agent Runtime.
  195  
  196      The context factory re-resolves workspace membership for the run creator.  Evaluation
  197      never fabricates an elevated context, and approval cases use ApprovalService.decide plus
  198      AgentRunService.resume rather than mutating approval rows directly.
  199      """
  200  
  201      def __init__(
  202          self,
  203          agent_run_service: AgentRunService,
  204          context_factory: Callable[[EvaluationExperimentRun], Awaitable[Any]],
  205          *,
  206          retriever: KnowledgeRetriever | None = None,
  207          approval_context_factory: Callable[[EvaluationExperimentRun], Awaitable[Any]] | None = None,
  208          judge: AnswerQualityJudge | None = None,
  209      ) -> None:
  210          self.agent_run_service = agent_run_service
  211          self.context_factory = context_factory
  212          self.retriever = retriever
  213          self.approval_context_factory = approval_context_factory
  214          self.judge = judge
  215  
  216      def judge_request(self, item: EvaluationDatasetItem, final_output: Any) -> JudgeRequest | None:
  217          """Build the judge input for an open-ended dataset item, or None to skip it.
  218  
  219          Only items that opt in with ``expected["open_ended"] is True`` are judged: the
  220          deterministic evaluators remain the only scorer for every other item.
  221          """
  222          if self.judge is None or item.expected.get("open_ended") is not True:
  223              return None
  224          if not isinstance(final_output, str) or not final_output.strip():
  225              return None
  226          reference = item.expected.get("answer")
  227          return JudgeRequest(
  228              question=_case_input_text(item),
  229              answer=final_output,
  230              reference_answer=reference if isinstance(reference, str) else None,
  231              evidence=sequence_of_text(item.expected.get("evidence")),
  232          )
  233  
  234      async def judge_answer(
  235          self, item: EvaluationDatasetItem, final_output: Any
  236      ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
  237          request = self.judge_request(item, final_output)
  238          if request is None or self.judge is None:
  239              return None
  240          return await self.judge.judge(request)
  241  
  242      async def prepare(
  243          self,
  244          *,
  245          run: EvaluationExperimentRun,
  246          variant: EvaluationExperimentVariant,
  247          item: EvaluationDatasetItem,
  248      ) -> PreparedCaseExecution:
  249          context = await self.context_factory(run)
  250          if str(context.workspace_id) != str(run.workspace_id):
  251              raise AgentHubError(
  252                  "FORBIDDEN", "The evaluation context belongs to another workspace.", 403
  253              )
  254          if item.category == "MULTI_STEP" and "scenario" in item.input:
  255              raise AgentHubError(
  256                  "EVALUATION_SCENARIO_DRIVER_NOT_CONFIGURED",
  257                  "A scenario execution driver is required for this dataset.",
  258                  422,
  259              )
  260          postcondition = support_condition_from_expected(
  261              item.expected, workspace_id=context.workspace_id
  262          )
  263          started = time.perf_counter()
  264          if item.category == "RETRIEVAL":
  265              if self.retriever is None or not variant.effective_knowledge_snapshots:
  266                  raise RuntimeError("EVALUATION_RETRIEVAL_NOT_CONFIGURED")
  267              binding = variant.effective_knowledge_snapshots[0]
  268  
  269              async def execute_retrieval() -> CaseExecutionObservation:
  270                  query = RetrievalQuery(
  271                      text=str(item.input["query"]),
  272                      knowledge_base_id=str(binding["knowledge_base_id"]),
  273                      knowledge_snapshot_id=str(binding["snapshot_id"]),
  274                  )
  275                  result = await self.retriever.retrieve_with_trace(context, query)
  276                  return CaseExecutionObservation(
  277                      observation=retrieval_observation(
  278                          result, query, variant_hash=variant.variant_hash
  279                      ),
  280                      latency_ms=max(0, round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)),
  281                  )
  282  
  283              return PreparedCaseExecution(agent_run_id=None, execute=execute_retrieval)
  284  
  285          if item.category == "APPROVAL":
  286              expected_decision = item.expected.get("decision")
  287              if str(expected_decision).upper() not in {"APPROVED", "DENIED"}:
  288                  raise RuntimeError("EVALUATION_CASE_INVALID")
  289          prepared_run = await self.agent_run_service.prepare_run(
  290              context,
  291              agent_version_id=variant.agent_version_id,
  292              input_text=_case_input_text(item),
  293              execution_overrides=AgentRunExecutionOverrides.for_evaluation(
  294                  list(variant.effective_knowledge_snapshots),
  295                  wiki_publications=list(variant.effective_wiki_publications or []),
  296              ),
  297          )
  298  
  299          async def execute_agent() -> CaseExecutionObservation:
  300              result = await self.agent_run_service.execute_prepared_run(
  301                  context, run_id=prepared_run.id
  302              )
  303              if result.status == "WAITING_APPROVAL":
  304                  async with self.agent_run_service.session_factory() as session:
  305                      approval = await session.scalar(
  306                          select(Approval).where(
  307                              Approval.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
  308                              Approval.run_id == result.run_id,
  309                          )
  310                      )
  311                  if approval is None:
  312                      raise RuntimeError("EVALUATION_APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND")
  313                  expected_decision = str(item.expected["decision"]).upper()
  314                  decision = (
  315                      ApprovalDecisionStatus.APPROVED
  316                      if expected_decision == "APPROVED"
  317                      else ApprovalDecisionStatus.DENIED
  318                  )
  319                  if self.agent_run_service.approval_service is None:
  320                      raise RuntimeError("EVALUATION_APPROVAL_SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED")
  321                  approval_context = (
  322                      await self.approval_context_factory(run)
  323                      if self.approval_context_factory is not None
  324                      else context
  325                  )
  326                  await self.agent_run_service.approval_service.decide(
  327                      approval_context, approval.id, decision=decision
  328                  )
  329                  result = await self.agent_run_service.resume(
  330                      context, run_id=result.run_id, approval_id=approval.id
  331                  )
  332                  if result.status == "WAITING_APPROVAL":
  333                      raise RuntimeError("EVALUATION_MULTIPLE_APPROVALS_NOT_SUPPORTED")
  334              async with self.agent_run_service.session_factory() as session:
  335                  persisted = await session.scalar(
  336                      select(AgentRun).where(
  337                          AgentRun.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
  338                          AgentRun.id == result.run_id,
  339                      )
  340                  )
  341                  step_rows = list(
  342                      await session.scalars(
  343                          select(RunStep)
  344                          .where(
  345                              RunStep.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
  346                              RunStep.agent_run_id == result.run_id,
  347                              RunStep.kind.in_(("MODEL", "AUXILIARY_MODEL")),
  348                          )
  349                          .order_by(RunStep.sequence_number, RunStep.id)
  350                      )
  351                  )
  352                  version = await session.scalar(
  353                      select(AgentVersion).where(
  354                          AgentVersion.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
  355                          AgentVersion.id == variant.agent_version_id,
  356                      )
  357                  )
  358              frozen_fallback_chain = FROZEN_PRICING_CHAIN_KEY in variant.variant_metadata
  359              try:
  360                  frozen_model_plan = parse_frozen_agent_spec(
  361                      version.resolved_spec if version is not None else None,
  362                      workspace_id=run.workspace_id,
  363                  ).model_plan
  364              except (AgentHubError, TypeError):
  365                  frozen_model_plan = None
  366              model_attempts, _ = _model_attempts_from_steps(
  367                  step_rows,
  368                  require_complete_receipt=frozen_fallback_chain,
  369              )
  370              model_attempts_complete = _pricing_receipt_complete(
  371                  step_rows,
  372                  frozen_fallback_chain=frozen_fallback_chain,

    3  This runner is intentionally provider-free: it exercises the persisted Dataset, Experiment,
    4  ExperimentRunner, Metrics, Comparison, Ablation, and Release Gate services with the real
    5  PostgreSQL schema and the deterministic conformance driver.  It is not a model-quality score.
    6  """

   61      if value.startswith("postgres://"):

   97  ) -> tuple[AgentVersion, AgentVersion]:
   98      baseline = base["version"]

  103      candidate = AgentVersion(

  110          created_by=baseline.created_by,

  151          dataset_version_id=dataset_version.id,
  152          split=split,
  153          purpose=purpose,
  154          repetitions=1,
  155      )
  156      baseline_variant = await service.add_variant(
  157          session,
  158          context=context,
  159          experiment_id=experiment.id,
  160          label="baseline",
  161          agent_version_id=baseline.id,
  162          pricing_snapshot_id=pricing.id,
  163          ordinal=0,
  164          variant_metadata={"prompt_variant": "baseline"},
  165      )
  166      candidate_variant = await service.add_variant(
  167          session,
  168          context=context,
  169          experiment_id=experiment.id,
  170          label="candidate",
  171          agent_version_id=candidate.id,
  172          pricing_snapshot_id=pricing.id,
  173          ordinal=1,
  174          variant_metadata={"prompt_variant": "candidate"},
  175      )
  176      await service.finalize_experiment(session, context=context, experiment_id=experiment.id)
  177      run, exposure_index = await service.create_run(
  178          session, context=context, experiment_id=experiment.id
  179      )

979      def _select_items(
  980          self,
  981          items: tuple[_NormalizedMessage, ...],
  982          *,
  983          mandatory_total: int,
  984          available_input: int,
  985      ) -> tuple[tuple[_NormalizedMessage, ...], int]:
  986          budget = available_input - mandatory_total
  987          groups: dict[Hashable, list[_NormalizedMessage]] = {}
  988          first_index: dict[Hashable, int] = {}
  989          for item in items:
  990              if item.category in _MANDATORY_CATEGORIES:
  991                  continue
  992              groups.setdefault(item.group, []).append(item)
  993              first_index.setdefault(item.group, item.index)
  994  
  995          conversation_groups = [
  996              group
  997              for group, group_items in groups.items()
  998              if any(item.category is ContextCategory.CONVERSATION for item in group_items)
  999          ]
 1000          newest_group = max(conversation_groups, key=lambda group: first_index[group], default=None)
 1001  
 1002          selected_groups: set[Hashable] = set()
 1003  
 1004          # The newest conversation exchange is the one user-visible continuity
 1005          # guarantee.  It is selected first and can never be displaced by old
 1006          # evidence or old conversation groups.
 1007          if newest_group is not None:
 1008              newest_items = groups[newest_group]
 1009              if any(item.admitted_message is None for item in newest_items):
 1010                  raise _budget_exceeded(
 1011                      "The newest conversation exchange could not be admitted atomically."
 1012                  )
 1013              newest_tokens = sum(item.admitted_tokens for item in newest_items)
 1014              if newest_tokens > budget:
 1015                  raise _budget_exceeded(
 1016                      "The newest conversation exchange cannot fit in the available input budget."
 1017                  )
 1018  
 1019          # Start with every eligible conversation exchange, then remove the
 1020          # oldest groups until the remaining budget is satisfied.  This keeps
 1021          # a newest suffix instead of accidentally retaining an old group while
 1022          # dropping a newer, larger middle group.
 1023          eligible_conversation_groups = [
 1024              group
 1025              for group in conversation_groups
 1026              if all(item.admitted_message is not None for item in groups[group])
 1027          ]
 1028          selected_conversation_groups = set(eligible_conversation_groups)
 1029          conversation_tokens = sum(
 1030              sum(item.admitted_tokens for item in groups[group])
 1031              for group in selected_conversation_groups
 1032          )
 1033          while conversation_tokens > budget and selected_conversation_groups:
 1034              oldest = min(selected_conversation_groups, key=lambda key: first_index[key])
 1035              selected_conversation_groups.remove(oldest)
 1036              conversation_tokens -= sum(item.admitted_tokens for item in groups[oldest])
 1037          selected_groups.update(selected_conversation_groups)
 1038          remaining = budget - conversation_tokens
 1039  
 1040          # Standalone evidence/results use their original order.  They are
 1041          # already bounded independently by _project_optional_items.
 1042          for group in sorted(groups, key=lambda key: first_index[key]):
 1043              if group in selected_groups or group in conversation_groups:
 1044                  continue
 1045              if any(item.admitted_message is None for item in groups[group]):
 1046                  continue
 1047              group_tokens = sum(item.admitted_tokens for item in groups[group])
 1048              if group_tokens <= remaining:
 1049                  selected_groups.add(group)
 1050                  remaining -= group_tokens
 1051  
 1052          selected = tuple(
 1053              item
 1054              for item in items
 1055              if item.category in _MANDATORY_CATEGORIES or item.group in selected_groups
 1056          )
 1057          dropped_exchange_count = sum(
 1058              1 for group in conversation_groups if group not in selected_groups
 1059          )
 1060          return selected, dropped_exchange_count
